results.title: Exact complexity of real Euclidean border rank
results.question: Classify the computational complexity of deciding whether a given rational 3-tensor lies in the Euclidean closure of real rank-at-most-r tensors. Is the threshold problem ∃R-hard or in ∃R?
results.result: Euclidean real border-rank threshold is in the existential theory of the reals using a one-block algebraic separation bound.

results.title: Effective equations for Segre secants
results.question: Can defining equations for fixed-rank Segre secants be generated uniformly with arithmetic size polynomial in the ambient tensor entries?
results.result: Polynomial-time generation of fixed-rank set-theoretic Segre secant equations, with an effective ideal-generation algorithm at fixed order.

results.title: Degree of growing Segre secants
results.question: Can exact degrees of Segre secant varieties be computed with polynomial complexity for fixed rank and variable formats?
results.result: Compute exact degrees of Segre secants in polynomial bit time for fixed rank and order, including unequal formats.

results.title: Dimension-optimal order reduction for fixed d
results.question: For fixed tensor order d not divisible by three, improve ordinary order-reduction output dimension from O(n^{ceil(d/3)}) to O(n^{d/3}) while preserving exact GL equivalence.
results.result: Equivariant polynomial order reductions require an output axis of dimension at least n^ceil(d/3).

results.title: Order reduction preserving randomness
results.question: Construct a polynomial-size order reduction from uniform d-tensors to a source ensemble with rigorously controlled density relative to uniform 3-tensors.
results.result: Deterministic exact fixed-format order reductions lose exponentially in output support density.

results.title: Repeated-spectrum numerical orbit approximation
results.question: Give polynomial-bit-time promised-gap O/U orbit-distance approximation when marginal eigenvalue multiplicities are bounded but arbitrarily close clusters and connected support are allowed.
results.result: Inverse-polynomial-gap O and U tensor orbit-distance approximation is NP-hard even with simple, separated marginal spectra and connected support.

results.title: Approximate counting onto fixed nonabelian simple targets
results.question: With a finite presentation for the source and a fixed nonabelian simple target, classify relative approximation of the number of onto maps on the positive-count promise.
results.result: For every fixed nonabelian simple target, a constant-factor randomized approximation on positive counts exists exactly if RP = NP.

results.title: Weighted faithful actions with competing point-stabilizer costs
results.question: Given a finite group and a value oracle assigning an explicit cost to each subgroup in a supplied candidate list, optimize faithful support using only these coset types when the socle has many repeated nonabelian factors.
results.result: Listed faithful coset types give exact weighted Set Cover on direct powers of a fixed simple group, yielding NP-completeness in compact input.

results.title: Computing minimum faithful linear dimension from compact groups
results.question: Given a finite permutation-generator group, classify polynomial-bit complexity of the least dimension of a faithful complex representation for class-two p-groups with fixed prime.
results.result: Minimum faithful complex dimension is NP-complete for compact class-two p-groups at each fixed prime, with polynomial-degree permutation generators.

results.title: Arithmetic field of definition for a smallest faithful action
results.question: For fixed p-groups given by compact generators, determine complexity of the smallest faithful linear dimension over Q, and bound its ratio to the complex dimension tightly in terms of exponent and center rank.
results.result: Minimum faithful rational dimension is NP-complete for compact permutation p-groups at every fixed prime. Rational versus complex dimension bounds are sharp at every exponent and center rank.

results.title: Valuation-sensitive H² size in mixed-characteristic tame extensions
results.question: Bound the number and length of invariant factors of H²(Q,A) for modules A over Z/p^eZ when p-Sylows of Q are tame and e grows, in terms sufficient for succinct orbit algorithms.
results.result: An r-relator Sylow presentation bounds H² by rd cyclic factors of explicitly bounded exponent, for arbitrary prescribed mixed-exponent actions.

results.title: Orbitals of an unordered family of compact groups
results.question: Given an unordered family of permutation subgroups all acting on the same domain, canonically compare its joint action under one ambient point relabeling and arbitrary family reordering in singly exponential time in the domain degree alone, polynomial in family length.
results.result: Singly exponential joint canonization of unordered compact permutation-group families via Wiebking's two canonizers.

results.title: Dimension-optimal black-box testing of nonassociative circuits
results.question: Find explicit finite-dimensional nonassociative evaluation algebras of near-minimal dimension that hit every nonzero size-s degree-d free nonassociative circuit, with efficient evaluation.
results.result: A universal explicit 2d-dimensional algebra over a transcendental evaluation extension detects free degree-d nonassociative polynomials over the base field.

results.title: Nonassociative PIT with unknown multiplication structure
results.question: Derandomize identity testing for circuits promised to be evaluated in a finite-dimensional nonassociative algebra when the structure constants are supplied as part of the input.
results.result: Functional identity over a supplied finite algebra is coNP-complete. Formal identity over a supplied algebra is equivalent to commutative PIT.

results.title: Fine-grained PIT for semantic set-multilinearity
results.question: Over Z, obtain the exponent t^{5d/6} up to polynomial factors in circuit size for circuits promised to compute set-multilinear polynomials without requiring syntactic set-multilinearity.
results.result: Deterministic t^(5d/6) times polynomial arithmetic work for semantic set-multilinear integer circuits, and a bit bound with bounded gate heights.

results.title: Derandomizing estimating symbolic degree
results.question: With a promised high-degree intermediate circuit DAG over Q but a small output degree, decide in deterministic polynomial bit time whether the formal output degree is at most the binary-specified d.
results.result: Semantic degree threshold with unbounded intermediate degree is many-one equivalent to PIT in the same promised circuit model.

results.title: Testing a succinct partial-derivative-rank promise
results.question: Given a circuit for a polynomial of bounded degree over Q, decide whether its full derivative-space dimension is at most r in time polynomial in size and r.
results.result: One determinant tests full derivative-space rank. This gives randomized polynomial bit time and a deterministic equivalence to bounded-degree PIT.

results.title: Inseparable powering reconstruction
results.question: Can sums of sparse-form powers be reconstructed uniformly when the characteristic divides the powering exponent?
results.result: Inverse Frobenius reduces inseparable power reconstruction to the coprime exponent, with proper polynomial-time recovery for pure characteristic powers.

results.title: Short refutations from compact multiplication tables
results.question: Can an explicit finite quotient-algebra multiplication table of polynomial size be converted into a polynomial-size IPS refutation of radical inconsistency without computing Gröbner bases in exponentially many monomials?
results.result: A correct one-dimensional quotient table leaves IPS search equivalent to general IPS search. Certified basis products suffice for efficient extraction.

results.title: Quantitative modular-to-integral dependence
results.question: Give effective bounds on the number of test graphs and their maximum order needed to distinguish a target pair violating a proposed dependent count identity, for inputs of bounded size.
results.result: Explicit test counts and maximum graph orders for modular-to-integral homomorphism dependence on bounded targets in the shift-lift families.

results.title: Small-characteristic GI proof-complexity separation
results.question: Construct one explicit nonisomorphic graph family giving asymptotically sharp degree lower bounds simultaneously in every fixed finite characteristic.
results.result: One explicit nonisomorphic graph family forces asymptotically sharp PC degree simultaneously in every fixed finite characteristic.

results.title: Recovery from a unique relaxed graph transporter
results.question: Determine polynomial-time conditions under which a unique solution in a computable GI relaxation can be rounded to an actual permutation without exponential branching.
results.result: A fractional graph transporter with an entry strictly above one half in each row rounds to an isomorphism, and the threshold is sharp.

results.title: Minimal genus of a homomorphism separator
results.question: Compute or sharply bound the least Euler genus of a graph whose homomorphism counts distinguish a given nonisomorphic pair.
results.result: Minimum separator Euler genus is uncomputable even at bounded degree. It has an O(n log n) upper bound and explicit linear lower bounds.

results.title: Banica hypergraph symmetry with natural operator-algebra action
results.question: Construct or rule out a hypergraph quantum-automorphism definition that recovers Banica graph symmetry and acts naturally on the hypergraph C*-algebra.
results.result: A uniform directed-hypergraph quantum group acts on the hypergraph C*-algebra and specializes exactly to Banica graph symmetry.

results.title: Hypergraph-product free-wreath quantum symmetry
results.question: Prove a precise quantum analogue of hypergraph product automorphism wreath-product theorems, specifying which products yield free wreath quantum groups.
results.result: A directed hypergraph block substitution has an explicit free wreath product quantum automorphism formula.

results.title: Quantum-versus-commuting isomorphism on bounded-degree graphs
results.question: Determine whether finite-dimensional quantum and commuting-operator graph isomorphism coincide on connected graphs of bounded maximum degree, or construct a bounded-degree separation.
results.result: Finite-dimensional and commuting quantum graph isomorphism separate on connected graphs of maximum degree 15, where the commuting problem is undecidable.
